# draw

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/draw"
```

Package draw renders the frame: text fitting, panels, header, tabs, status and overlay compositing. Everything measures screen cells, truncates, and never wraps, so callers can count rows and get the terminal's answer.

```go
func Card(r layout.Rect, title, body, footer string, st PanelStyle) string
```

<a name="Composite"></a>
## func [Composite](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/composite.go#L12>)

```go
func Composite(fg, bg string, x, y int) string
```

Composite draws fg over bg at \(x, y\), replacing only the cells it covers and keeping the rest of each bg line, escapes included. This is what lets a modal float over the panes instead of blanking them.

<a name="KV"></a>
## func [KV](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L160>)

```go
func KV(key, value string, keyStyle lipgloss.Style, width int) string
```

KV is one labelled row: the key padded to 14, the value after it, the whole line cut to width. Both halves are sanitized, since either may be something a server chose.

## func [Panel](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/panel.go#L31>)


<a name="Sanitize"></a>
## func [Sanitize](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/safe.go#L11>)

```go
func Sanitize(s string) string
```

Sanitize renders server\-supplied text so drawing it can only draw: OSC 52 sets the clipboard, CSI forges a confirmation modal, bidi \(CVE\-2021\-42574\) reorders a line. Rendering only \- the clipboard still sees the real bytes.

<a name="SanitizeLines"></a>
## func [SanitizeLines](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/safe.go#L42>)

```go
func SanitizeLines(s string) []string
```

SanitizeLines handles legitimately multi\-line text \- a policy, a role's configuration \- keeping the breaks and neutralising the rest. A trailing carriage return is CRLF and not content, so a Windows document reads clean.

<a name="ScrollTo"></a>
## func [ScrollTo](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L101>)

```go
func ScrollTo(s string, height, target int) string
```

ScrollTo returns a window of at most height lines from s that keeps line target \(1\-based\) visible, roughly centred. target \< 1 yields the top.

<a name="ShortDuration"></a>
## func [ShortDuration](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L183>)

```go
func ShortDuration(d time.Duration) string
```

ShortDuration renders a lifetime the way a header has room for: the two largest units that say anything, truncated rather than rounded, so a countdown never shows more time than is left.

<a name="ViewportGutter"></a>
## func [ViewportGutter](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/gutter.go#L11>)

```go
func ViewportGutter(style lipgloss.Style) viewport.GutterFunc
```

ViewportGutter is a viewport line\-number column with the same shape as Gutter, so a viewport and a NumberLines block line up side by side. The viewport probes the width with a zero context, hence the fixed format.

<a name="Width"></a>
## func [Width](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L130>)

```go
func Width(s string) int
```

Width is how many cells s takes on screen, escapes ignored.

<a name="Wrap"></a>
## func [Wrap](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/text.go#L47>)

```go
func Wrap(s string, width int) []string
```

Wrap folds plain text into rows of at most width cells, breaking after spaces and hyphens and cutting a word wider than a row. Newlines stay; style the rows after wrapping, since a style is not re\-opened per row.

<a name="ChromeStyle"></a>
## type [ChromeStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/chrome.go#L13-L20>)

ChromeStyle colours the rows around the panes.

```go
type ChromeStyle struct {
    Title     lipgloss.Style // header title
    Info      lipgloss.Style // header subtitle and right-hand text
    Tab       lipgloss.Style
    TabActive lipgloss.Style
    Status    lipgloss.Style
    Dim       lipgloss.Style // empty-state message and hint
}
```

<a name="PanelStyle"></a>
## type [PanelStyle](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/draw/panel.go#L15-L19>)

PanelStyle colours a panel: Border inks the edges, Title the label in the top edge. Edge is the box\-drawing set, rounded when zero; a focused panel can wear a thicker one so focus survives a terminal without colour.

```go
type PanelStyle struct {
    Border lipgloss.Style
    Title  lipgloss.Style
    Edge   lipgloss.Border
}
```
